sort_evidence: PF-07868489 is an anti-BMP9 antibody in pulmonary arterial hypertension (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06137742); its Phase 2 extension NCT07073820 is active, not recruiting, and the book holds no other row for it.

trials.title: A Study to Learn About the Study Medicine (Called PF-07868489) in People With Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension Who Have Previously Participated in a Clinical Study With PF-07868489
